set.body:
Keep compile-time registration. Move modality-specific filename defaults out of the generic interpreter and register only the operations a profile implements.

Acceptance criteria

1. Add a small fixture profile with assessment only. It compiles and admits a file without supplying an editor, subset compiler or placeholder methods.
2. The packaged API and console report which operations each installed profile supports. Attempts at unsupported operations return an explicit typed result.
3. The MRI and behavioural view/edit fixtures, described EEG, and preserved archive keep their existing semantics. The same registry supplies the service's actual dispatch and its capability report.

Verification

Registry tests plus packaged capability/dispatch checks. Coordinate the broader UI with existing multimodal X03.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: PRO01: Register assessment, editing and view preparation independently
